provenance: independent case-specific native WebGL procedural ocean/sky, cached smooth meshes, articulated robot, lamp/radio/boat and native vector characters; no reference visual image or movie playback; independent public-domain Natural Earth polygon atlas

captions.speaker: PIP
captions.text: Another night, old friend. Let's keep the light burning.

captions.speaker: MIRA
captions.text: Hello? Is anyone there? Please… our ship can't find the shore.

captions.speaker: PIP
captions.text: I'm here. Don't be afraid. Just follow my light.

captions.speaker: CAPTAIN
captions.text: We see it! Hard to port, steer for the beam!

captions.speaker: MIRA
captions.text: The light… it's gone! Mom, I can't see anything!

captions.speaker: PIP
captions.text: Follow it, Mira. All the way home.

captions.speaker: MIRA
captions.text: You saved us. Now it's our turn.

captions.speaker: CAPTAIN
captions.text: Go on, love. Give it back its light.

attribution.creator: faroukzy
attribution.story_dialogue: Original attributed fiction: robot PIP, daughter MIRA, mother CAPTAIN.
attribution.audio: Original reference comparative soundtrack; independent music/voice synthesis not implemented

limitations: Original CGI meshes, rig, source shaders and audio synth were not recovered; native smooth geometry and analytical waves/cameras approximate actual source shots.
Fonts and character expression/hair/hand/cloth, photoreal water/cloud and optical lighting remain approximate. No full-fidelity approval.
Native ocean surface adds a cached 60×60 grid displaced and lit in GPU with two analytic wave components; still not original simulated water. Glass pane alpha and metal lower wall panels added.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
